text: Good evening. I am the aunty, my nephew is 7 years, he is staying with me this week. His temperature is 39.9 I checked it two times now. Mira, he also has eczema and it is flaring up, the dry itchy patches on his arms and neck, he is scratching it the whole time, I have put his cream already. Apart from that I don't have anything else to report, he is just hot. I have done this before so abeg don't give me long story, tell me straight: what should I do with this temperature tonight, do I give medicine and watch him or what is the plan? Gracias.
